inquiry: salam, me and 5 friends want to go skardu next month for 5 nights. we are students so budget is tight, maybe 300 dollars each max. we can share rooms. all pakistani. can you make something?

brief.notes: Students, room sharing acceptable, domestic travellers so no foreign permits
